label: cold shock response
definition: A stress response in which a rapid temperature downshift induces nucleic-acid-binding cold-shock proteins and RNA-remodeling functions that preserve gene expression at low temperature.
observations: Acute cold-stress response branch of the stress-response hierarchy; distinct from broader response-to-cold terms and narrower cold-shock-protein, cold-shock-domain, RNA-helicase, and cold-exposure terms.
